Class is back in session at Paiso Ki Pathshaala, and Episode 2 turns up the heat!
With sharper buzzers, trickier finance questions, and high-stakes money challenges, the competition gets tougher as teams battle it out using financial knowledge, strategy, and teamwork.
From quick-fire quiz rounds to clever money challenges, every decision counts. The pressure keeps rising, the leaderboard keeps shifting, and only the smartest money moves survive.
Who takes the lead this time?
